headline: How Investors Are Reacting To Electronic Arts (EA) Surging Q1 2026 Earnings And EPS Growth
summary: Electronic Arts Inc. has already reported first-quarter 2026 results, with sales rising to US$1,986 million from US$1,671 million and net income increasing to US$397 million from US$201 million a year earlier. Basic earnings per share from continuing operations effectively doubled year on year, highlighting how improved profitability is filtering through to shareholders.
